title: [SDUI][P2] App & Utility page types (pageType app/utility)
body:
## Context
`pageType: 'app'` and `pageType: 'utility'` are defined in the schema but **not implemented** — no synthesis, no assignment, no renderer wiring. Cross-page navigation is not schema-driven.

## Goal
Support app-level and utility pages as assignable, schema-rendered surfaces, enabling schema-driven cross-page navigation.

## Scope
- Assignment + render wiring for `pageType: 'app'` and `'utility'`.
- Minimal default synthesis or blank-canvas authoring.
- Hook into the (schema-driven) navigation tree so these pages are reachable.

## Acceptance
- [ ] An authored `app`/`utility` page renders via `SchemaRenderer`
- [ ] Reachable from schema-driven navigation
- [ ] Editable via PageDesigner (depends on page persistence)
